newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends losing streak, techs show strength.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends losing streak, techs show strength.

text.p: Nasdaq shares ended a four-session losing streak Thursday as several large capitalization technology stocks rebounded.

The Nasdaq composite index added 12.77 points, or 1.06 percent, to close unofficially at 1213.77. Nasdaq shares rallied after slipping early in the day to below 1200, a low not seen since September 1996. The session was mixed with losing issues beating gains 2383 to 1878.
The Nasdaq's gain countered a loss by the Dow industrials, which fell almost 40 points to close at 6477.
Traders said they saw some "rare strength" in several bellwether technology stocks, which rallied despite a selloff in International Business Machines Corp.

"There was some real nice turn around in some key OTC tech stocks today. Techs have been really oversold lately, so it's good to see some recovery," said Nicholas Karos, senior over- the-counter trader at Piper Jaffray.

Intel Corp gained 3-5/8 to 140-5/8, Microsoft jumped 3-1/8 to 95-1/8 and Dell Computer added 1 to 68-3/4. HBO & Co gained 5-1/8 to 48-3/4 after Dean Witter Reynolds upgraded it to buy from accumulate.
